title: Commercial Fleet Account Standing Rate for Kessler Care Fleet Plan Addenda
content:
**Account standing rate.** For a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, the account standing rate reads the customer's service account in its Service Accounts and Repair Orders records, together with that account's late fees. The window is the 12 whole months before the pricing date, which is the day the addendum is signed. A late fee falls inside the window when its line date is fewer than 12 whole months before the pricing date.

| Service account tier | Late fee in the window? | Account standing rate |
|---|---|---|
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | None | 0.03 (3 percent) |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | None | 0.015 (1.5 percent) |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 or Net 15 | One or more | No account standing rate |
| Any other account (Service Guest Account or an Owner Rewards tier) | Not relevant | No account standing rate |

The account standing rate is a fraction of the addendum's basis price.

## Window edge (hypothetical dates)
With a hypothetical pricing date of 15 May:
- A late fee dated 16 May of the year before is 11 whole months back. It is inside the window and removes the rate.
- A late fee dated 15 May of the year before is 12 whole months back. It is outside the window and does not affect the rate.

## Points of judgement
- Only a late fee charged on the service account counts against the standing. Other repair-order lines, payments and credits do not.
- A Net 30 account with one late fee in the window takes no account standing rate.
